_description: Per-runtime-environment support map for Cursor surfaces (ide-local / cli-headless / cloud / tab), authored alongside the Phase 5 doctor environment diagnostics that render it (doctor-cursor-environment.ts). Complements compliance/native-surface-matrix.json (a per-SURFACE view) with a per-ENVIRONMENT view: which hook events fire, where skills/agents/rules are discovered from, which MCP transports work, and what a cloud-exposed project loses. `documented` = the official doc source states this for that environment; `undocumented` = the docs are silent and no live test has closed the gap — treated as authority-propagation risk, default deny-by-omission; `not-applicable` = this environment structurally does not have the concept.

environments.cloudCompatibilitySummary: n/a — this IS the local IDE environment.

skillsDiscoveryPaths.note: A community forum bug report (not official docs) claims the Cursor CLI does not load ~/.agents/skills/ (only the GUI does) — unverified, needs a live smoke test before relying on it.

environments.cloudCompatibilitySummary: n/a — headless CLI is a local execution mode, distinct from Cloud Agents.

unsupportedEvents.note: beforeMCPExecution/afterMCPExecution are the enforcement gap this phase's --allow-cloud-mcp gate and doctor hard-FAIL exist to cover — an MCP tool call in a Cloud Agent has NO local hook enforcement equivalent. User-level ~/.cursor/hooks.json is also NOT loaded in cloud (project/team/enterprise hook config is).

skillsDiscoveryPaths.note: Cloud Agent support for custom skills specifically is not directly confirmed in the source research pass — treated as undocumented, not assumed working.

mcpTransportsSupported.note: stdio servers depend on the cloud VM and cannot be pre-verified before agent launch; HTTP MCP credentials (refresh tokens/headers) are never present in the cloud VM.

environments.cloudCompatibilitySummary: Hooks: most local hooks run except session/tab/workspace-lifecycle and prompt-type hooks; user-level hook config is excluded. MCP: stdio + HTTP only (no SSE/mcp-remote), no local beforeMCPExecution enforcement — this is why applying an MCP profile to a cloud-exposed project requires the explicit --allow-cloud-mcp opt-in, and why doctor reports a hard FAIL (not a note) for an installed profile in a cloud-exposed project.
n/a — Tab is an IDE-only autocomplete surface, never runs in Cloud.

openQuestions: MCP config precedence across project/user/team levels — undocumented on the pages fetched (docs report Q3).
Subagent MCP inheritance (does a subagent see the parent's configured MCP servers?) — undocumented (docs report Q4).
Cloud Agent support for custom agents/subagents, skills, and rules specifically — not directly confirmed; only hooks + MCP are confirmed cloud-side.
Whether the Cursor CLI loads ~/.agents/skills/ — sourced from an unverified community forum report, needs a live smoke test.
